exact_statement: For much of early training of 70M, 160M, and 410M PlainLM models on FineWeb, the displayed stochastic local-smoothness proxy is well approximated by a line in stochastic training loss.
verification_rule: All named model scales and the paper-scale early-training window must pass a predeclared positive-slope, confidence-interval, and permutation check.
falsification_rule: A negative result counts only when model, data, optimizer, initialization, batch, sequence, tokenizer, precision, and early-training horizon match the paper.
